'''Cornelius Wagglehorn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] at [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he was present in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], from where he hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] through [[Unidentified Corellia University teaching assistant|his assistant]] to find out what had happened at the [[Corellia University research outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], with which he had lost contact. The spacer discovered that members of the [[Cult of Exar Kun]] had come and forcibly recruited the researchers and the students at the outpost, so Wagglehorn had the spacer infiltrate and destroy the [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]].

==Behind the scenes==
Professor Cornelius Wagglehorn was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Cornelius Wagglehorn was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
